faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits HP Envy M7-U109DX, M7-U009DX, 17t-U000, 17-U011NR, 17-U110NR, 17-U163CL and 17-U177CL. Note SG03XL also comes in a larger 61.6Wh 4-cell variant for the same model line — the part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
